choices.title: Version managers for many languages
choices.advice: Pick one at most. Both do the same job. mise is faster and reads asdf's files. If you use one of these, you can skip the single-language managers below.

choices.title: Node.js version managers
choices.advice: Pick one at most. All three decide which `node` runs, and two at once fight over your PATH. fnm is the fastest, nvm is the most widely documented.

choices.title: Python version and project tools
choices.advice: Usually one. uv covers Python versions and projects. pyenv only does versions. Poetry only does projects.

choices.title: Ways to run containers
choices.advice: Pick one. Each runs its own Linux VM, and most also claim the `docker` command. OrbStack is the lightest. Docker Desktop is what most teams document.

choices.title: Window layout
choices.advice: Pick one. Rectangle snaps windows with shortcuts. AeroSpace and yabai arrange every window for you, and they take more setup.

choices.title: Launchers
choices.advice: Pick one. Both replace Spotlight's shortcut.

aerospace.title: Allow AeroSpace under Accessibility
aerospace.detail: macOS only lets you grant this yourself. Open System Settings, turn on AeroSpace, then come back.

xcode.title: Get Xcode from the App Store
xcode.detail: Apple needs you signed in to your Apple Account for this download. When Xcode appears, Soulcaster finishes the rest and asks for your password once.
